passives.name: Defense System (Overheating)
passives.description: (Passive Effect)Takes increased damage from Light and Dark enemies, and enemies always attack with a favorable attribute. Takes increased damage from AoE attacks. All enemies’ Speed becomes 0, and they are afflicted with Extra Skill Disabled and Extra Turn Disabled (permanent). After your attack, increases all enemies’ Priority by [Buff_V_4086013_4_4]. Damage from Curses/Fixed Damage cannot exceed [Buff_V_4086013_4_5]/[Buff_V_4086013_4_6] respectively. However, Fixed Damage from Skill Chains can be up to [Buff_V_4086013_4_7]. On battle entry, dispels all enemy buffs. At the start of turn, enemies at 30% HP or less have all buffs dispelled and their HP set to 1.

passives.name: Hymn of Courage
passives.description: (Passive Effect)The enemy team gains courage against despair, receiving special effects based on their roles. Striker: +500% Critical Damage to all allies per Striker ally Mage: +[Buff_V_4086014_5_2_1] ATK to all allies per Caster ally Defender: On action, heals all allies by +[Buff_V_4086014_5_4_1] HP Ranger: On action, grants all allies a Shield for [Buff_T_4086014_5_3_1] turns Healer: On action, reduces the boss’s WG by [Buff_V_4086014_5_5] Enemy team’s Skill Chain damage increases per ally of the same attribute. WG damage taken from Assist and Skill Chains is reduced by 100%.
